1.description: Reworked Contagion: The final tick of your Corruption deals 30/60/90/120/150% increased damage.

7.author: Nimzo(474296015814524928)
7.description: Your Riptides create a healing effect at the feet of the target ally. All allies standing within will be healed each second for 6 seconds, and Chain Heals cast on these targets will be 15% more powerful.

7.author: Nimzo(474296015814524928)
7.description: Your Greater Heal, Flash Heal and Penance spells now also heal all targets affected by your Renew for 20% of the amount. Also reduces the mana cost of Renew by 20%.

7.author: Nimzo(474296015814524928)
7.description: The tooltip of Tidal Mastery has been updated.

7.author: Nimzo(474296015814524928)
7.description: Wild Felfire now triggers the Rain of Fire on all Chaos Bolt casts, instead of being limited to critical hits.

7.author: Nimzo(474296015814524928)
7.description: New Legendary RE - Transcendental Embrace: Your bond with nature infuses you with power. Every 10 seconds your Chain Heal has its cast time reduced by 10% and reach increased to affect an extra target. This effect can be stored up to 3 times.

7.author: Nimzo(474296015814524928)
7.description: New Legendary RE - Expunge: Your Chimera Shots have a 100% chance to leave a lingering poisons on the target dealing Nature damage every 3 seconds for 15 seconds and stacking up to 3 times. Upon reaching 3 stacks the poison is expunged from the target, dealing Nature damage (half to players) to the target and enemies within 10 yards.

7.author: Nimzo(474296015814524928)
7.description: New Legendary RE - Seed of Life: Your periodic heals from Regrowth and Rejuvenation plant a Seed of Life in the target, healing them each second for 4 seconds and stacking up to 8 times. Upon reaching 8 stacks the seed blooms and heals the target and up to 5 nearby allies.

5.description: Reworked the 5-piece setbonus of Striker's Garb (T2.5): Your Arcane Shot and Explosive Shot abilities grant you 15 Ranged Attack Power for 10 seconds, stacking up to 10 times.
